newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June construction orders down 6.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan June construction orders down 6.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Orders received by 50 major Japanese construction companies in June fell 6.5 percent from a year earlier to 1.30 trillion yen, the Construction Ministry said on Thursday.
In May, orders rose 6.2 percent year-on-year to 1.27 trillion yen.
The ministry also released construction figures for the April-June period which showed a decline of 5.5 percent from the same period a year earlier to 3.57 trillion yen.
